title: Voice AI Agent Framework
summary: Real-time streaming voice agent framework built with FastAPI, React 19, and WebSockets. Integrates low-latency STT via Groq, TTS via Cartesia, vector RAG with PGVector and Jina AI, and domain-specialized PydanticAI bots for finance, healthcare, legal, travel, and Jira.
highlights: Real-time streaming audio pipeline integrating Groq STT and Cartesia TTS.
Domain-specialized PydanticAI agents for finance, healthcare, legal, travel, and Jira.
RAG vector retrieval pipeline powered by PGVector and Jina AI embeddings.
Full-duplex WebSocket browser transport with a React 19 frontend UI.
